arrivalScene: A delivery van arrives at the farm. The rear doors open, and a new contract worker steps out into the yard, holding a small bag and looking around uncertainly. Alpha stands nearby with arms crossed, silently watching the arrival. Beside him, on the grass, stands a large metal cage with its door open — empty, waiting for its new occupant. The cowshed, chicken coop and pigsty are visible in the background. The air is cold, dusk is falling. Alpha gestures toward the cage. The contract worker walks slowly toward it, glancing back.

story_officeCage: {player} rises from the desk and nods toward the metal dog cage standing in the corner of the office. {npc} shifts her gaze from the cage to {player} but does not move. He repeats the order. She walks over slowly, lowers herself to her knees and climbs inside, ducking her head under the low top. {player} closes the door, the latch clicks. The key turns in the lock. {npc} sits down on the floor of the cage, wrapping her arms around her knees. {player} pockets the key, returns to the desk and sits down. The office is quiet again, only the clock ticking.
